rules: OAT ten groups; both HX price factors vary together as one explicit correlated scenario.
Hold each physical design and supply group fixed during all assumption comparisons.
Tritium price changes initial stock capital as well as annual purchases.
Other-load sensitivity covers only generator_auxiliaries.other_electric; cryogenic/control assumptions remain held.
Repeat six source controls at inherited assumption settings; preserve adverse status.
All scenarios are engineered sensitivity settings, not source boundaries, probabilities or optimized choices.
